title: Let mobile context breathe
summary: Important hospital, shift and selected-night context now stacks naturally on phones instead of being compressed or truncated.
changes: Changes and Breaks no longer squeeze Main Operating Theatres beside the Mater Dei logo; the unit label can use its own line and never ellipsises.
Selected-night staffing moves into a small context chip so the date navigator gets the full card width and can show the complete date and roster-night label.
Shift identity remains prominent with a large artwork tile, full shift name and wrapping tagline rather than sacrificing team personality for density.
Primary context across Night, Changes and Breaks now wraps instead of truncating when screen width or text scaling needs more room.
